title: HtmlEm
responsibility: Renders the native em element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlEm.attributes
inputs.description: Native em attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlEm.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native em element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlEm
outputs.description: The actual native em element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
